model.name: Censored free-intercept log-linear growth
model.observation_model: Independent Normal errors on log10 parasites/mL; ND contributes Pr(log10 P < 1) for the 10 parasites/mL detection limit.

diagnostics.baseline_comparison: Retained baseline: a fixed 48-h sinusoid lowered in-sample error but LOO RMSE was 0.126 vs 0.275 log10 for baseline; LOO log score was -16.97 vs -4.45, indicating overfit.
